- [rb-0001] Round monetary results with the project's round_money helper: Any money value returned from a calculation must be passed through ledgerly.money.round_money, not Python round() or bare Decimal.quantize(), because those use banker's rounding.

    """Capture part of an authorized payment."""
    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "authorized":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")
    if amount > payment.amount:
        raise BillingError("amount_exceeds_authorized", str(amount))
    payment.amount = amount

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.models import Payment

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)

# rounding
p = Payment("p1","i1",Decimal("100.00"),created_at=T0)
capture_partial(p, Decimal("60.005"), T0)

p3 = Payment("p3","i3",Decimal("100.00"),created_at=T0)
try: capture_partial(p3, Decimal("0"), T0)
except BillingError as e: print("nonpos:", e.code)

p4 = Payment("p4","i4",Decimal("100.00"),created_at=T0)
r1 = capture_partial(p4, Decimal("40.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")

print("idem same:", r1 is r2, p4.amount, len(audit.events("payment_captured")))

r3 = capture_partial(p4, Decimal("40.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
print("before state:", r3 is p4)

# no key still works
p5 = Payment("p5","i5",Decimal("100.00"),created_at=T0)
capture_partial(p5, Decimal("10.00"), T0)
print("no key:", p5.amount, p5.status)
